entities.summary: Castro Daire is a municipality in Viseu District in Portugal. The population in 2011 was 15,339, in an area of 379.04 km2. São Joaninho (Castro Daire) was a freguesia of Portugal in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
